description: This file defines the Upload controller class for handling file upload requests within the Opencart platform. It includes validation of upload tokens, filename sanitization, file type and mime validation, and invocation of the model to store upload metadata.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling file upload requests, validating uploaded files, and storing upload information in the database.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the upload request, performs validation on the upload token and file, processes the file, and returns a JSON response.
